## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.grants_credit` | `object` | Credit this price grants. `{"kind":"pack", …}` on a one-time price: each paid invoice line grants `amount` × quantity (paid credit, active once the invoice is paid). `{"kind":"per_cycle", …}` on a recurring price: `amount` × item quantity of promotional credit each period, with optional rollover. Null grants nothing. |
| `data.meter` | `string` | Bill from this meter's events. Models usage, tiered, volume or package. The usage aggregation is copied from the meter. Fixed after create. |
| `data.unit_amount_decimal` | `string` | The default rate: minor units per `quantity_divisor` units. A decimal string with at most 12 decimal places and no exponent, for example `"0.000125"`. "$3 per 1M tokens" is `"300"` with divisor 1000000. |
| `data.quantity_divisor` | `integer` | The rate is per this many units. Default 1. |
| `data.amount_source` | `string` | `rate` (default): quantity × rate. `event_amount`: the sum of the events' `amount`. `event_cost`: the sum of `cost` × (1 + `markup_percent` ÷ 100). `model_price_list`: each combination at the selling rate: a fixed rate in `rates`, else its markup base × (1 + markup ÷ 100); a combination with no base bills `unit_amount_decimal`. `event_cost_or_list`: the events that carry a `cost` bill that cost × (1 + markup ÷ 100), on their own line; the events without one (or with a cost in another currency) bill as `model_price_list`; a fixed rate for a combination wins over both. The last two: the usage model only, on a sum or count meter with a `price_list` mapping. One of `rate`, `event_amount`, `event_cost`, `model_price_list`, `event_cost_or_list`. |
| `data.markup_percent` | `string` | `event_cost`, `model_price_list` and `event_cost_or_list` only: a decimal percent, 0 or more, up to 6 decimal places. |
| `data.markup_base` | `string` | `model_price_list` and `event_cost_or_list` only. `list` (default): the model price list, else your cost. `cost`: your cost, else the list. One of `list`, `cost`, `null`. |
| `data.rates` | `array of object` | The rate card. A combination that no row names bills at the price's own rate. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The price's id (`pro-monthly-usd`). |
| `data.product` | `string` | The product this price belongs to (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |
| `data.name` | `string` | The price's name. |
| `data.model` | `string` | The pricing model. |
| `data.type` | `string` | Whether the price recurs or is charged once. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The price's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.amount_minor` | `integer` | The amount in minor units (integer), e.g. 2900 = $29.00. |
| `data.minimum_amount_minor` | `integer` | Minimum spend for one billing period, or null. |
| `data.bill_usage_monthly` | `boolean` | New subscriptions on this price invoice metered usage every month. |
| `data.commitment_amount_minor` | `integer` | Minimum commitment for one full billing period, or null. |
| `data.interval` | `string` | The billing interval of a recurring price. |
| `data.usage_aggregation` | `string` | How usage in a period is combined, or null for a fixed price. |
| `data.usage_recurring` | `boolean` | The measured level carries into later periods. |
| `data.usage_time_unit` | `string` | The unit of a weighted_sum quantity, or null. One of `hour`, `day`. |
| `data.metered` | `boolean` | The price bills measured usage in arrears, not a fixed quantity. |
| `data.is_taxable` | `boolean` | Whether tax applies to this price. |
| `data.tax_behavior` | `string` | Whether the price includes tax or tax is added on top. |
| `data.show_description_in_invoices` | `boolean` | Whether the price's description is printed on invoices. |
| `data.show_description_in_quotes` | `boolean` | Stored and round-tripped; no quote renderer exists yet to honour it. |
| `data.tax_code` | `string` | HSN/SAC for this price (India GST). Null falls through to the product’s, then the business default_tax_code. |
| `data.sku` | `string` | SKU. Descriptive metadata — the engine reads it nowhere. |
| `data.accounting_code` | `string` | Accounting code (“Account Name”). Descriptive metadata — NOT a ledger account reference. |
| `data.accounting_category_code` | `string` | Accounting category code (“Class”). Descriptive metadata. |
